title.en: Legislative Analyst, The 2012-13 California Spending Plan (General Fund spending $91.3 billion)
Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 3, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: General Fund spending was $91.3 billion in the 2012-13 Budget Act, the year the Proposition 30 rates began. The Analyst for Proposition 3 says the state plans to spend about $250 billion from the General Fund this year. That is an increase of about $159 billion, or about 2.7 times. Context: these are unadjusted General Fund figures, not adjusted for inflation or population, and the argument does not say which spending measure it uses.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument against Proposition 3

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 3

text: Since the “temporary” increases were first passed, government spending has increased by $150 billion—a more than 2.5X increase.
